Introducing @muse, the personal agent that understands your goals and works 24/7 to get things done for you.
Your Muse gets its own private computer in the cloud to do work for you. We've built new technology so the Muse Secure VM keeps your content safe.
We want everyone to have access to personal superintelligence, so we're providing Muse for free for up to 100 million tokens per week.

Muse Spark 1.3 is rolling out today with frontier performance almost too cheap to meter. This is the biggest jump we've made so far on coding and agentic work. Try it in Muse Code and our API.
Next up 🍉 and Muse Spark open weights releases coming soon.

Muse Voice Transcribe is MSL's first real-time audio perception model -- rolling out today. SOTA in streaming speech-to-text, it handles speaker diarization, and endpointing natively in a single model.
Sorry, we're having trouble playing this video.
Learn more

The model decides when to listen. It waits a little longer on hard words and commits faster on easy ones, using adaptive delay to predict each token and increase accuracy. With adaptive delay, the model is near the pareto front on speed-accuracy tradeoff.

posts.text: #photodump from this summer now that we’re back in California and the boys are back in school

Thought I’d share this on Threads to and see what the hot takes might be. We updated the Instagram wordmark today, which is more than a decade old and felt dated. We feel the refresh is sharper and more modern, but references the original and has the simplicity and craft that's always made it Instagram.

We’re expanding translations to more languages on Instagram – added Japanese, Korean, French, German, and Italian. You can also now translate both your voice and any on-screen captions in the same reel together, which should make things a lot easier. We’re also rolling out more languages for translations on Facebook, including Bahasa, Indonesian, Arabic, French, Vietnamese, and Thai. More to come soon.
Excited about this launch. I've been really impressed with how quickly the MSL team has been able to improve their first model in such a short amount of time.

We’re sharing three helpful ways Gemini can help you navigate tough bureaucratic hoops, like renewing a driver’s license or preparing your taxes. ↓ 🧵

📃 Filing forms and paying fees
Gemini can act as a translator for confusing government language, helping you break down step-by-step requirements before you fill out forms or head to a local agency.
Try this prompt: I’m registering a newly purchased car in ______. Can you give me a simple, step-by-step checklist of the documents, fees, and forms I need to prepare before visiting the DMV?

☑️ Participating in civic life
From jury duty to voting procedures, Gemini can help break down local rules and outline an action plan for you.
Try this prompt: I have upcoming jury duty in ______ for the first time. What should I expect from the selection process, what to bring, and general court protocols?

🤝 Accessing social services
Gemini can summarize the eligibility criteria for different social and public services so you can prepare your applications with confidence.
Try this prompt: Can you explain how the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) application process works and list the key medical and work history documents needed to apply?
